# Fixed demonstration rankings

These files were regenerated against the packaged ontology during publication preparation on 5 November 2026. The candidate class descriptions are unchanged from the preceding demonstration; the new ranking/profile binds the scores and decisions to the current ontology hashes.

- `rankings.json`: full scored candidate lists and original model/file provenance.
- `review-template.json`: pending selections generated by the ranker.
- `pilot-profile.json`: profile built from the separately recorded fictional review decisions.
- `profile-coverage.json`: coverage from the fictional pilot and two enrolment inputs.

These are declared regression fixtures, not hidden caches. `check_mapping.py` reads them directly, so its 31 checks require no downloaded model or ignored output folder. `check_operational_interface.py` separately executes live ranking with a configured local model and encoder environment. Fresh operational outputs belong in an ignored working folder.
